title: Synthetic Tabular Data Generation with Scikit-Learn and SDV
summary: A pipeline for generating synthetic versions of the KDD Cup '99 network intrusion detection dataset and evaluating classifier performance (Random Forest, Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression) on original versus synthetic data mixes. It runs SDV's single-table synthesizers (GaussianCopula, CTGAN, CopulaGAN, TVAE) via sdv.single_table and evaluates them with sdv.evaluation.single_table's evaluate_quality.
evidence: synthetic_generator.py:68-115,204: instantiates GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer via sdv.single_table and calls evaluate_quality
